datasets.title: Mozambique Displacement Data - IDAI Cyclone Sites Tracking
datasets.description: DTM is tracking in/out movement of displaced people in 4 Provinces hit by IDAI cyclone.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mozambique-displacement-data-daily-sites-tracking-iom-dtm]

entity.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM) - Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)

lineage.description: IOM DTM collected daily tracking data on population movements (in/out flows) at displacement sites across 4 Mozambique provinces affected by Cyclone IDAI, generating time-series records of displacement counts from March 2019 onwards using standardized DTM site monitoring protocols.

sources.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM) - Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)
sources.description: IOM DTM standard methodology for tracking in/out movement of displaced persons at displacement sites following the IDAI cyclone event
